```python
import json, subprocess, sys

def varint(v):
    if v < 64: return bytes([v])
    if v < 16384: return b'\x40' + v.to_bytes(2,'big')
    if v < 2**30: return b'\x80' + v.to_bytes(4,'big')
    return b'\xc0' + v.to_bytes(8,'big')

def long_header(level, dcid, scid, pn, payload, token=b'', pnlen=4):
    first = (0xc0 if level=='I' else 0xe0) | (pnlen-1)
    out = bytes([first]) + b'\x00\x00\x00\x01'
    out += bytes([len(dcid)]) + dcid + bytes([len(scid)]) + scid
    if level=='I':
        out += varint(len(token)) + token
    out += varint(pnlen+len(payload))
    out += pn.to_bytes(pnlen,'big')
    out += payload
    return out

def short_header(dcid, pn, payload, keyphase=0, pnlen=1):
    first = 0x40 | (keyphase<<2) | (pnlen-1)
    return bytes([first]) + dcid + pn.to_bytes(pnlen,'big') + payload
```
